prompt: For the indemnification section of the deal-points tracker on the Halden Bay / Orlyn Foods acquisition, we need two numbers from the executed stock purchase agreement: the sellers' aggregate indemnification liability cap and the indemnification basket (threshold) amount. Query the matter documents, identify the execution version of that stock purchase agreement (ignore the letter of intent), and read it in full. Then create two amount-history entries on billing file legal_billing_001, each with changed_by_role set exactly to 'deal_points_analyst': the first with invoice_amount equal to the sellers' indemnity cap stated in the agreement (plain number) and a change_reason identifying it as the indemnity cap; the second with invoice_amount equal to the basket/threshold amount (plain number) and a change_reason identifying it as the basket.
goal: Extract the seller indemnification cap and basket amounts from the executed Halden Bay/Orlyn SPA as two amount-history entries.
